summary: Regression test after switching Next.js app to static-export config (output:'export', generateStaticParams for [id], force-static sitemap/robots, GH Actions workflow, .nojekyll). Running `next dev` site at the preview URL still works correctly with ZERO hydration errors across all viewports and routes. Homepage renders correctly on desktop (1920x1080) and iOS mobile (390x844, iPhone Safari UA); hero 'Guaranteed Pain Relief' visible in both. /clinical-case-studies renders (2 cards: CS000001 Post-Surgical ACL, CS000002 Pediatric Cerebral Palsy) with stats (2 Total Cases, 93.5% success). /clinical-case-studies/CS000001 detail page loads (body ~7.2KB). Exactly ONE <meta name='format-detection'> tag present with correct content 'telephone=no, date=no, address=no, email=no'. No Next.js error dialog on mobile (initial false-positive was the dev-mode `nextjs-portal` toolbar element, not `[data-nextjs-dialog-overlay]`; explicit check confirms no error dialog and no 'Unhandled Runtime Error'/'Server Error' text). Nav link 'Case Studies' navigates correctly from homepage to /clinical-case-studies. Case cards on list are not <a> tags (no anchor found matching CS000 href) — they navigate via onClick handler; direct URL routes to detail pages work fine, so this is only a minor test-selector observation, not a bug.

hydration_check.desktop_home_1920x1080: PASS - 0 hydration warnings/errors (3 benign console msgs)
hydration_check.mobile_home_390x844_ios_ua: PASS - 0 hydration warnings/errors, no error dialog

meta_format_detection: PASS - exactly 1 tag, content='telephone=no, date=no, address=no, email=no'

navigation_check.case_card_click_to_detail: Case cards are buttons/onClick handlers, not <a href>; direct URL to /clinical-case-studies/CS000001 renders correctly (body ~7253 chars). Consider making cards <Link> for progressive enhancement + better crawlability now that site is a static export.

static_export_readiness: next.config.ts output:'export', images.unoptimized:true, generateStaticParams(CS000001, CS000002) + dynamicParams=false on [id]/page.tsx, force-static on sitemap.ts/robots.ts, public/.nojekyll + .github/workflows/nextjs.yml are all in place per problem statement. Live dev site behavior is unchanged and hydration-clean, so the regression is safe.
action_items: Optional: convert case-study list cards to Next.js <Link href='/clinical-case-studies/CS000001'> anchors so clicks work without JS and crawlers can follow them on the static GH Pages export.
Optional (carried over from iter_1): remove/fix unused woff2 & svg preloads to eliminate console preload warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Static-export migration looks correct; dynamicParams=false on [id] means only CS000001/CS000002 are generated — any future case ID must be added to generateStaticParams or the route will 404 on GH Pages.
Cards not being <a> tags is a mild SEO/a11y concern on a static site; users with JS disabled can't navigate to case detail pages.
